landing.headline: Meal planning that actually adds up.
landing.subhead: Calorie-targeted plans, deterministic nutrition and shopping lists that write themselves. AI optional — never required.

features.nutritionBody: Every calorie and macro comes from a curated database — reproducible, never invented.
features.plansBody: Multi-day plans that hit your calorie target and reuse ingredients to cut waste.
features.listsBody: Shopping lists merged, unit-normalised and grouped by aisle.
features.aiBody: Bring your own OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter or Ollama key. Works fully without one.

profile.title: Profiles
profile.subhead: A profile drives the deterministic calorie engine. An account can have up to {max} profiles — one per household member, or to compare diet scenarios. Editing a profile recalculates its targets; deleting one also removes its meal plans and shopping lists.
profile.atLimit: You have reached the limit of {max} profiles. Edit one above, or delete a profile to create a new one.
profile.name: Name
profile.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Its meal plans and shopping lists are removed too.
profile.preferencesSubhead: Per-profile lists that bias and constrain meal-plan generation. Avoid entries are skipped entirely; favourites are softly preferred. Allergens (configured separately) are always honoured.
profile.favouritesHint: The planner leans toward recipes using these.
profile.avoidHint: The planner skips recipes that contain these.
